# Test clips

`hi_1.wav`, `hi_2.wav`, `ta_1.wav`, `bn_1.wav` are from Google's FLEURS
dataset (test split), licensed CC-BY-4.0
(https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs). `clips.tsv` lists each
clip's FLEURS sentence id, file name and transcription. Used unchanged
(16 kHz mono WAV) to test Tark's live captions (D4).

`golden.json` is generated by `utils/captions_export.py golden` from these
clips, AI4Bharat's IndicConformer (MIT) and Silero VAD (MIT).

`mt_cases.tsv` lists 16 caption hypotheses: the four clips' IndicConformer
output from `golden.json` and 12 more from the D4 spike's IndicConformer runs
on other FLEURS test sentences (CC-BY-4.0). `mt_golden.json` is generated by
`utils/indictrans_export.py golden` from them, AI4Bharat's IndicTrans2
(MIT) and IndicTransToolkit's IndicProcessor (MIT): every stage of the
reference translation pipeline, for Tark's translation engine tests.
